layer_naming_rule: Layer 1 is the World Model Layer. Stage-A is only a historical implementation entrypoint such as stage_a_demo.py.

canonical_run_steps.name: Input Layer
canonical_run_steps.description: Collect and normalize RGB, depth, and provided pose inputs.

canonical_run_steps.name: World Model Layer
canonical_run_steps.description: Build rich-semantic, light-geometry indoor world model.

canonical_run_steps.name: Formal Artifact Layer
canonical_run_steps.description: Export formal topology, connector, object-interface, stable occupancy map, and provenance artifacts.

canonical_run_steps.name: Navigation Interface Layer
canonical_run_steps.description: Consume formal artifacts, including stable occupancy maps, to build downstream routing/execution-facing resources.

canonical_run_steps.name: Runtime Validation Layer
canonical_run_steps.description: Validate interfaces and demonstrations without expanding claims beyond observed evidence.

stable_occupancy_map_contract.description: A floor-wise navigation raster generated from World Model Layer BEV/free-space/wall/outside-boundary/gateway evidence.
